data.text: **Question:** Explain the internal working of the CLR and garbage collection.
CLR manages .NET execution. GC automatically manages memory using generations (0, 1, 2) and a Large Object Heap. Finalizers and IDisposable provide deterministic cleanup.

CLR provides memory management, type safety, exception handling. GC uses generational collection: Gen 0 (short-lived), Gen 1 (buffer), Gen 2 (long-lived). LOH for large objects. Finalizers run non-deterministically, IDisposable provides deterministic cleanup.
